meta.source: Built Nov 2026 from the Parcelwise brand guideline and design system (knowledge-base/branding-guideline, knowledge-base/design-system), in three print formats (A4 trifold, A5 postcard and recto flyer). Sizes are stored in px at 96 dpi (1 mm = 3.7795 px, 1 pt = 1.333 px), which CSS treats as the same physical length, so sheets print at true size. Each usage note opens with the print value.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Parcelwise Navy. CMYK 72 37 0 64 (verify against the printer's profile). The navy ground on every front, cover and close; figures, headings and icons on paper (10.5:1 on paper).

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Panels on the navy ground (evidence strip, contact tile surround). Never text.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Meridian Gold. CMYK 0 29 76 24. The one highlight on paper: the highlighted lot, a 1pt eyebrow rule, the top weight bar. Never text on paper (2.7:1).

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Gold on the navy ground: the motif's lot and up to three highlighted words in a claim (5.2:1 on navy).

tokens.name: ink-raw
tokens.usage: Ink. Body copy on paper and white panels (15.4:1 on paper). Print as rich black only above 24pt; body stays 100K-equivalent ink.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Slate. Weight-bar tracks, inactive layer outlines, chart baselines. Not text below 14pt (3.6:1 on white).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Paper. The inside of every piece. Print as a 4% K tint on bright white stock, or leave unprinted on an off-white uncoated stock (ask the printer for a drawdown). Also all text on the navy ground.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: White panels on paper (feature, figure, evidence panels) and the QR tile on navy. Panels carry a hairline, never a shadow.

tokens.name: grey-text
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper and white: captions, labels, source lines (5.4:1 on paper, 6.0:1 on white).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Panel borders and dividers on paper, 0.5pt.

tokens.name: navy-text
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the navy ground: supporting lines, labels, source lines (5.8:1 on navy).

tokens.name: navy-line
tokens.usage: Dividers and panel outlines on the navy ground, 0.5pt.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The ground. Paper inside; flat navy on fronts, covers and closes. Never a gradient, glow or photo as a full ground.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: A raised panel on the ground: white with a hairline on paper, navy-deep on navy.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, claims and figures.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running copy.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, labels and source lines.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one gold element per panel or card side. Marks only on paper; on navy also up to three highlighted words.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Line icons: navy on paper, paper on navy. Never gold, never two colours in one icon.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and panel outlines.

styles.name: tri-claim
styles.sample: Know which customers to call this month. And why.
styles.usage: 20 / 24 pt. Claim on the front panel, navy ground, left-aligned. One idea per line, up to 12 words.

styles.name: tri-heading
styles.sample: What changes for your lending team
styles.usage: 15 / 18 pt. Panel headings inside and on the back. Two lines at most.

styles.name: tri-panel-title
styles.sample: Built on data you already own
styles.usage: 11 / 14 pt. Title of a feature panel, beside or under its icon. One line.

styles.name: tri-body
styles.sample: Every moment links to a named customer record in your CRM, with the data points behind it.
styles.usage: 10.5 / 15 pt. Running copy. 40–55 characters a line on a 100 mm panel.

styles.name: tri-figure
styles.usage: 26 / 28 pt. Figures in a FigurePanel, navy on white. Always followed by a label and a source line.

groups.name: A5 postcard and recto flyer (210 × 148 mm)

styles.name: card-display
styles.usage: 30 / 33 pt. One statement on a navy front, up to eight words. Replaces card-headline, never sits with it.

styles.name: card-headline
styles.sample: Your next refinance is already in your CRM.
styles.usage: 22 / 26 pt. Headline above a figure or diagram, up to 14 words.

styles.name: card-lead
styles.sample: Parcelwise shows which existing customers to talk to next, and why.
styles.usage: 13 / 18 pt. One supporting sentence under the display line or headline.

styles.name: card-subhead
styles.usage: 12 / 15 pt. Column heads on a card back.

styles.name: card-body
styles.sample: Moments arrive in your CRM with the evidence behind them.
styles.usage: 10 / 14 pt. Body copy on a card back.

styles.name: page-title
styles.sample: Moments your risk team can sign off
styles.usage: 28 / 31 pt. Title of a leave-behind, under the plot-strip motif. Two lines at most.

styles.name: page-lead
styles.sample: Parcelwise combines your own customer data with external market data, and every moment shows its evidence.
styles.usage: 12 / 17 pt. The paragraph under the title, up to three lines.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: 7.5 / 10 pt. Uppercase label above a heading, +0.08em tracking, set in CSS. The one all-caps element.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: 8 / 10 pt. Layer chips, diagram labels, evidence rows. 8pt is the floor for any sans text.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: 8 / 10 pt. Weights, IDs and dates inside diagrams; tabular figures.

styles.name: source
styles.sample: Backtest on a lender's 2025 book · illustrative
styles.usage: 7 / 9 pt. Source line under every figure, chart and diagram. 7pt is the floor for print; never on screen below 9pt.

styles.name: contact
styles.usage: 10 / 14 pt. Web and email lines in the ContactBlock.

spacing.note: Stored in px at 96 dpi so CSS and the design-system page read them (1 mm = 3.7795 px); CSS mm and px are the same length, so sheets still print at true size. The mm value opens each usage note.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 2 mm. Icon to its title; figure to its label; label to its source line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: 4 mm. Gap between stacked panels; padding of small panels and chips' row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: 6 mm. Padding of feature, figure and evidence panels; heading to its content.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 8 mm. Text inset from each fold and trim on the A4 trifold.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: 12 mm. Outer margin on A5 cards and the A4 one-pager.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: 16 mm. Gap between sections on the one-pager; space above the contact block.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Grounds, motifs, chips, QR tile. The default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: 0.5 mm. Panels and image frames (≈2px on screen). The maximum on any flyer; never pills or circles.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Panel outlines, dividers, layer-chip outlines. Thinner than 0.25pt disappears in print.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Eyebrow rule (gold), weight bars, the active layer outline.

print.note: Production values. Every PDF goes out as PDF/X-4 with fonts embedded and these marks.

tokens.name: bleed
tokens.usage: On every edge. Grounds and motifs run into it; nothing readable does.

tokens.name: safe
tokens.usage: Minimum distance from trim or fold to any text, logo or QR code.

tokens.name: fold-panel
tokens.usage: Width of the two outer panels of an A4 roll-fold trifold (front and back).

tokens.name: fold-flap
tokens.usage: Width of the panel that folds in. 3 mm narrower, so it closes without buckling.

tokens.name: qr-min
tokens.usage: Minimum QR size including its quiet zone; 4 modules of quiet zone on white.

tokens.name: logo-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the mark alone; the lockup is at least 32 mm wide.

tokens.name: image-res
tokens.usage: Effective resolution of product screenshots at final size. Export UI at 3× its screen size.
